## Description

Builds a comparable-company peer set and benchmarks the target's KPIs (margins, growth, leverage, ROIC) against it — the cross-sectional counterpart to `historical-financial-analysis`'s time-series base rate. Both feed `growth-projection-modeling`'s anchor check. Use when: "peer benchmarking", "comparable company analysis", "peer multiple comparison", "industry benchmark".
